note: Exit stories. Facts from the Black Lake exit posts (Set Solutions 2023, SpinnakerSCA 2024) and the April 2026 A5 press release; quotes are the published testimonials. No deal multiples are published. A5 facts from the BLC April 2026 press release (Drive; approved for distribution).
title: Your success is our story

items.summary: Black Lake invested alongside Third Century Partners. Set Solutions was acquired by Trace3, backed by American Securities, with TM Capital as exclusive financial advisor.
Formed in 2021 through the merger of SCApath and Spinnaker, with Black Lake and Source Capital as investment partners. SpinnakerSCA was acquired by Publicis Sapient, part of Publicis Groupe.

During Black Lake’s investment, A5 expanded through the acquisitions of Ramsey Solutions, Cloudware Connections and SnapBI, and secured an investment from Salesforce Ventures. A5 was then acquired by Accordion.
